com.esignal.jstandard.beans

Class ResourceConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.ResourceConfig

  • public class ResourceConfig
extends java.lang.Object
    Purpose of this class is to load configurations for JStandard API. The class implements a singleton pattern. It loads the properties at the start of the application. It also provides helper methods to read the property values by supplying name of the property. Internally it uses the "apache commons configuration" implementation. So, the properties can be defined using the rules defined by the open source API. Here's a list of properties files that it loads (in this order):
    jstandard.properties
    jstandard-defaults.properties
    In general, jstandard.properties are defined by the clients. All the default properties are defined inside the jstandard-defaults.properties as part of the jar so that client doesn't need to worry about those.
    Since:
    01-001-0007
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
